errors.evidence: The vertical axis range is 0 to 40, not 0 to 30.
The correct label is IE-Indic, not IE-Indo.
The values for IE-Indic are incorrect; the figure shows approximate values ranging from 17 to 23, not including 2 or 12.
The Semitic group includes negative values (around -8), which are not reflected in the description.
The description does not mention that the error bars for the Semitic group are notably larger, as indicated in the atom checklist.
The description omits the tick interval of 5 units on the vertical axis.
